attachments.origin_landmark: hard palate and the palatine aponeurosis
attachments.insertion_landmark: posterior border of the thyroid cartilage and the pharyngeal wall

actions: elevates the pharynx and larynx in swallowing

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Forms the posterior tonsillar pillar. Its medial pull closes the oropharyngeal isthmus behind the bolus.
